name: Museum of Contemporary Art and Design (MCAD)
funding: Run by De La Salle-College of Saint Benilde; Art Circle patrons and benefit auctions (2018, 15 Nov 2025) with Leon Gallery as auction partner.

name: Ateneo Art Gallery
funding: University museum of Ateneo de Manila University, founded 1960 on Fernando Zobel's gift of his collection; later donors, including artists, added works.

name: Metropolitan Museum of Manila
funding: Formerly central-bank subsidised. Now a non-profit foundation (1979, Imelda Marcos, Bienvenido Tantoco Sr.). Founding benefactors include Campos family firms NutriAsia and Del Monte Philippines. Metrobank and NCCA back programmes.

name: KALEKTAR research platform on Belarusian contemporary art
funding: German Federal Foreign Office (Civil Society Cooperation programme) and Rönne-Stiftung, per the platform's own about page

name: Bunkier Sztuki Gallery of Contemporary Art
Cricoteka (Centre for the Documentation of the Art of Tadeusz Kantor)
funding: Cricoteka is an Instytucja Kultury Województwa Małopolskiego, a cultural institution of Małopolska.

name: MOCAK
funding: Municipal museum of the City of Kraków, with a car-dealer partnership.

name: Belarusian Council for Culture (Rada Kultury)
funding: European Union (ArtPower Belarus, €2M over 28 months, delivered with the Danish Cultural Institute). Listed partners: ABBA, RESET!, Forum of National Platforms, NDF.

name: Kupalaŭcy (Free Kupala Theatre in exile)
funding: Ticket sales. Polish Ministry of Culture (Culture Promotion Fund) honorary award, 17 Mar 2025. EU ArtPower Belarus project grants. Diaspora crowdfunding. Two projects funded via Pavel Latushka's foundation.

name: Museum of Free Belarus
funding: Project of Pavel Latushka's National Anti-Crisis Management. Polish Ministry of Culture and National Heritage co-financed Digital Culture 2025. City of Warsaw provides its premises. Donors via PayPal and crypto.

name: Muzeum Sztuki Nowoczesnej w Warszawie (MSN)
funding: The City of Warsaw financed the building in full from its budget. The Ministerstwo Kultury i Dziedzictwa Narodowego earlier guaranteed 179,6 mln zł.
